name: Cheekscreen
description: Each pace keeps the hatchet raised across the line of the body, so the guard travels with the user.

name: Cruel Billet
description: As the front foot lands the chop falls with it, so the weight of the step rides the cut.

name: Gagging Poll
description: Pushing off the rear foot, the user hooks the opponent's arm and pulls it into a stumble.

name: Fellzip
description: Two fast shuffles close or widen the gap to the opponent while the hatchet hand stays still.

name: Chockslap
description: Qi surges down the arm at the instant of the stride, driving the bit through a raised guard.

name: Keen Kerf
description: Circling to the opponent's blind side, the user lands a qi-backed chop where no guard stands.

name: Stalling Eye
description: A light tap on the rim of the raised guard shows where it will move before the real cut.

name: Grim Splinter
description: Sliding off the guard's outer edge, the hatchet falls on the shoulder behind it.

name: Lassoing Heel
description: The beard hooks over the top of the opponent's guard and pulls it down, exposing the face.

name: Billetcurl
description: Dropping beneath a high guard, the user steps through along the opponent's side.

name: Rooted Poll
description: Both forearms cross to check a counter-cut while the hatchet is held back for a second try.

name: Eyethwack
description: Qi gathers at the edge as the hatchet slips past the guard and cuts the arm behind it.

name: Coasting Bit
description: A pivot with qi in the calves carries the user past the guard and behind the opponent's shoulder.

name: Brisk Helve
description: Two angled cuts meet at a point, as on a sapling's trunk, and a chip of the opponent's cover flies off.

name: Cramping Beard
description: The flat of the head strikes a held weapon and sends a jolt up the arm like a rebound off green wood.

name: Eyebuckle
description: Hatchet and free forearm form a fork that stops a descending cut between them.

name: Pollglide
description: Leaning around an imagined trunk, the user steps wide and comes up on the opponent's flank.

name: Heelswat
description: A shallow chip is struck and the hatchet rebounds straight into a second cut.

name: Rushing Chock
description: Dragging the edge down an arm, the user peels away sleeve and skin as bark comes off a trunk.

name: Kerf Slap
description: With qi gathered at the bit, a single angled cut is aimed at a limb as a woodsman fells a sapling.

name: Vicious Kerf
description: Ducking under a swing like a falling bough, the user rises inside it with a qi-backed chop.

name: Rill Heel
description: The beard drags an incoming haft off its line while the head stays poised to answer.

name: Ember Bit
description: The hook pulls the opponent's arm wide, and the chop falls on the side left open.

name: Static Chock
description: A tug with the beard behind the neck of a bent opponent yanks the head downward.

name: Gall Billet
description: The hook scoops behind an ankle and sweeps the foot away in mid-step.

name: Sleet Beard
description: Hooking a shield's top edge, the user drags it aside and holds it there.

name: Brass Poll
description: Feet set and weight low, the user braces so the hatchet cannot be wrenched from the grip.

name: Brisk Eye
description: Qi in the wrist drives pull and chop together as one connected motion.

name: Honedbit
description: While the hook reels the opponent in, a chop falls the moment they arrive.

name: Grit Toe
description: Retreating along the line of the pull, the user draws the hooked opponent forward and off balance.

name: Clayfell
description: A short downward chop clears a gap in the press without swinging wide.

name: Hum Poll
description: Shoulder and flat of the head shove a bystander or foe aside to open a lane.

name: Firm Cheek
description: Raised above the head, the hatchet shelters its user against blows thrown over the crowd.

name: Poise Haftswell
description: A parry made with the elbow pinned keeps the hatchet from fouling the people nearby.

name: Draught Heel
description: Turning the shoulders sideways, the user slips through a narrow gap between bodies.

name: Beardflog
description: With a shoulder against a rail or post for support, a qi-backed chop is thrown without any wind-up.

name: Cheekslap
description: A backhand cut behind the user's own shoulder strikes a pursuer hidden by the press.

name: Sturdy Eye
description: The helve rolls over the wrist and sweeps an incoming blade aside.

name: Brawn Helve
description: The head traces a small loop beside the wrist and cuts the opponent's hand on the way back.

name: Staticpoll
description: Sliding the hand up the helve in mid-swing, the user shortens the cut and lands it inside the guard.

name: Hazebit
description: The helve is pressed hard against the forearm, making a firm pin against a heavy cut.

name: Weighty Kerf
description: Rolling the head under a thrust, the beard hooks the wrist and binds it for a moment.

name: Slinking Toe
description: A springing hop backward from the heels opens the distance as the hatchet snaps to guard.

name: Crimson Fell
description: Qi turns the wrist faster than the eye follows, and a counter chop lands on the opened arm.

name: Padded Beard
description: One turning motion of the helve deflects the blade and carries the bit into the opponent's wrist.

name: Toeswat
description: A chop at the top rim of a shield bites the wood and shakes the arm behind it.

name: Ruthless Beard
description: Drawing the edge across the shield's arm strap, the user parts the leather under strain.

name: Toe Hasp
description: The beard catches the shield's top and yanks it down, dropping the cover.

name: Viselike Helve
description: A rap beside the shield's center makes the holder's wrist sting and the cover waver.

name: Heelhasp
description: The hatchet is held just above the user's own shield rim to catch cuts that come over it.

name: Armored Bit
description: An incoming blow is let slide along the rim and over the shoulder.

name: Ducking Billet
description: A crouching step slides the user under the shield's lower edge and inside its swing.

name: Poll Flog
description: With qi packed into the bit, one chop splits the shield's rim and travels on toward the arm.

name: Tethering Beard
description: The beard locks over the shield arm's elbow and qi-driven pull drags it clear of the body.

name: Rude Handlenub
description: Right after the crack of the rim, a second qi-charged chop falls through the gap it opened.

name: Wild Axehew
description: A flick of the wrist throws the head forward before the opponent sees the arm move.

name: Resolute Poll
description: The hatchet touches the incoming blade lightly while the body slips out of its path.

name: Gritheel
description: One short step, taken in a single breath, leaves the opponent's blow cutting empty air.

name: Clutching Bit
description: The beard taps the opponent's wrist and snags it for an instant, spoiling the next stroke.

name: Billetswat
description: A sharp burst of qi in the wrist doubles the speed of the chop at the last moment.

name: Emberhelve
description: The user cuts and, in the same breath, turns out of the opponent's answering line.

name: Poll Thwack
description: Chopping straight down as on a split log, the bit seeks the grain of the opponent's raised arm.

name: Rough Fell
description: The head lands narrow-edge first, driving in like a wedge that spreads the guard apart.

name: Humkerf
description: The butt of the helve slaps the opponent's ribs and checks a rushing advance.

name: Stalwart Toe
description: Feet rooted as if around a stump, the user braces the hatchet across the body against any shove.

name: Poise Beard
description: Short rapid taps of the helve break up an incoming flurry into harmless splinters of motion.

name: Fleet Billet
description: A woodland sidestep, light and low, takes the user around a thrust as around a root.

name: Brawnbit
description: Qi packed behind the narrow edge turns the wedge-bite into a cut that drives through cover.

name: Dire Poll
description: One stepping stroke, aimed at the leg as at the base of a tree, fells a standing opponent.
